legal_units.title: Charge of Income-tax.
legal_units.text: Where any Central Act enacts that income-tax shall be charged for any tax year at any rate or rates, income-tax for such tax year shall be charged at that rate or those rates in accordance with and subject to the provisions of this Act.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 4 Charge of Income-tax. Section 4(1): Where any Central Act enacts that income-tax shall be charged for any tax year at any rate or rates, income-tax for such tax year shall be charged at that rate or those rates in accordance with and subject to the provisions of this Act.

legal_units.title: Charge of Income-tax.
legal_units.text: The charge of income-tax under sub-section (1) shall be on the total income of the tax year of every person as per the provisions of this Act.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 4 Charge of Income-tax. Section 4(2): The charge of income-tax under sub-section (1) shall be on the total income of the tax year of every person as per the provisions of this Act.

legal_units.title: Charge of Income-tax.
legal_units.text: Income-tax shall also include any additional income-tax, by whatever name called, levied under this Act.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 4 Charge of Income-tax. Section 4(3): Income-tax shall also include any additional income-tax, by whatever name called, levied under this Act.

legal_units.title: Charge of Income-tax.
legal_units.text: If this Act provides that income-tax is to be charged in respect of income of a period other than the tax year, it shall be charged accordingly.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 4 Charge of Income-tax. Section 4(4): If this Act provides that income-tax is to be charged in respect of income of a period other than the tax year, it shall be charged accordingly.

legal_units.title: Charge of Income-tax.
legal_units.text: For the income chargeable under this section, income-tax shall be deducted or collected at source or paid in advance as provided under this Act.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 4 Charge of Income-tax. Section 4(5): For the income chargeable under this section, income-tax shall be deducted or collected at source or paid in advance as provided under this Act.
